# ScaleHaven

> ScaleHaven is a done-for-you marketing agency for med spas, aesthetic clinics, and plastic surgery practices in the US and Canada. We run Meta Ads, Google Ads, and SEO that deliver financially qualified patients, with optional follow-up automation, and guarantee 15+ booked consultations in a client's first month, or we work free until they hit it. Founded by an operator who grew a cosmetic clinic into one of the largest in its region before it sold to a private equity firm.

Contact: john@scalehaven.io. Book a call: https://calendly.com/john-scalehaven/30min
